messages:
jamie: Heads-up — planning a mini-wave at 03:20 UTC to push runtime 2.14.1 and a router header-swap. Need a cross-service pin for api/runtime/console/router, small traffic slice (10%). ETA ~20m.
chris: @jamie do we need a canary first or straight mini-wave? any DB/schema touches? :eyes:
jamie: No DB migrations. It's a KV-prefetch tweak + header mapping change that affects router -> runtime header translation. Canary preferred but fine as mini-wave if ops ok.
leo: Can you paste the rollout command so deploybot can be queued? want to validate pin durations.
jamie: Sure — this is what I'm gonna trigger:
```
deploy-bot release --wave=mini-9 --components=api,runtime,router,console --pin=30m --traffic=10%
```
chris: Pin 30m sounds good. Rollback trigger? smoke tests flapping?
jamie: Rollback criteria: any 5xx spike >1% over baseline for 5m, or KV miss rate increase >2x. Rollback command is:
```
deploy-bot rollback --wave=mini-9 --to=runtime:2.14.0,router:stable --reason="smoke-fail"
```
maria: I'll update the release notes + changelog snippet (small: "router header mapping fix; KV prefetch throttle"). Adding owners: @jamie @leo.
deploy-bot: queued release mini-9 (api,runtime,router,console) — scheduled for 03:20 UTC. Pin=30m. Notifying oncall.
sre-bot: monitoring runbook: https://internal/runbooks/mini-wave — alert if svc_latency_p90 > 250ms or error_rate > 0.8%.
leo: Quick Q — does console depend on the new header key name? any temporary compatibility shim?
jamie: console reads via api so no direct change. Router will send both headers for 10m during the window (compat shim) then drop old key. shim is safe.
chris: OK. I'll be around for the window. If smoke test fails, i'll trigger rollback.
deploy-bot: starting rollout: phase=canary (5% traffic) -> monitoring 5m
jamie: Canary started. Observing logs now.
leo: seeing one elevated 500 in api at t+2m, investigating stack trace, looks like a header parse NPE from a bad edge case.
chris: recommend abort and rollback, NPE tied to header rename even with shim.
jamie: Acknowledged. Aborting rollout and rolling back now.
deploy-bot: abort accepted. initiating rollback to pinned versions.
jamie: Rollback complete. All services back to stable. Confirming no lingering pins.
maria: Patch the release notes: mark this as "aborted: header-compat edge case fixed in next attempt" and create follow-up ticket to add additional parsing guard.
sre-bot: Post-rollback checklist: remove temporary pins, run smoke tests (passed), monitor for 30m.
chris: :thumbsup: good catch. Next attempt we should add a unit test for header missing/null cases and re-run canary with only router+runtime first.
jamie: Agreed. I'll file the ticket and schedule another mini-wave later this week after tests. Thanks everyone.
